findings.description: Switching the missing-argument check from truthiness to 'is None' lets an empty-string argument through. retry_if_exception_message(match='') is now accepted instead of raising TypeError, and it compiles to an empty pattern that matches every exception.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes match='' with message omitted. Before, both checks treated '' as missing and raised TypeError. Now the empty pattern is compiled and _check returns True for any exception, so retries fire on every error, including ones meant to stop retrying. Impact: silent over-retrying in production instead of an immediate configuration error.
